verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt is live at developer.intuit.com (HTTP 200), structured per product, and it includes payroll-specific QuickBooks Workforce API sections covering schema, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks and workflow use cases. An agent can be pointed directly at it to reach payroll developer docs. Missing for 10: a payroll-dedicated or llms-full.txt agent doc rather than an Intuit-wide umbrella index, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
